Results.ReviewText: Bought a Weber E325 NG grill new end of may 2026. Had no issues till July when i couldn’t turn the middle knob. Finally got it to turn then it happened again and could not turn the gas off at all. Had to turn the main line off. I contacted Weber and had to send pictures. Come to find out the middle knob had melted. That’s why it would not turn off. They made it good and they were very nice about replacing the knobs. I prefer things made to last and I can’t see these knobs lasting. Everything is plastic these days. They need to go back to using metal products.
Results.Title: Bad knobs on NEW WEBER GRILL

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for sharing your feedback on the Spirit E-325 Gas Grill. We are glad to hear that you find it easy to clean and spacious enough for your cooking needs! 

We appreciate your comments regarding the temperature and the propane tank scale. It can take time to adjust to the burners. If you need low and slow we would recommend turning the two outside burners to low and keeping the middle burner off to create an indirect heat zone. 

Your feedback is incredibly valuable and we will share this with our product design team for future improvements.

If you need immediate assistance please reach out to us direct. Thank you!

Results.Title: Overall good

Results.ReviewText: I bought this nearly a year ago, so doing a review NOW is a true eval of the grill. I'm 77 Yrs. old and have had five Propane gas grill in that time. I take extremely good care of my Grills. Opted for this Sprit 3 burner as it is now just me and my wife. I am compelled tom say, the Weber grill is without any doubt, the  best I've ever owned. I find the best thing is how easy it is to set a Temp and have it stay exactly there. The second best is the ease of Grate cleaning, High heat a scrub them hard, they look just past brand new. I cook two/three times a week. I have the Weber Rotisserie to do Chickens, Pheasants and roast beef. Again temp control is the key to the best results. Weber does not produce Junk, this is GOOD quality and will more that likely be my last grill, Thank you, Weber.
Results.Title: Temp control

ClientResponses.Response:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback with us regarding your new grill. We are glad to hear that you appreciate the lighter weight of the hood, but we are genuinely sorry to learn that the overall design has made your cleaning routine so frustrating. 

We completely understand how inconvenient it is to have to turn the entire grill around just to access the grease tray. Your feedback is incredibly valuable and our goal is to always improve user experience. If you need any further assistance please reach out to us direct. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: The grill is ok. Smaller cook space than our previous one, same style. I like that the cover/hood weighs less. However….why in the world would you design the grill where you have to remove and clean the tray FROM THE REAR!?!  Illogical!!  I have to believe that most people back their grills up to a railing or building. I now have to totally turn the grill around to access the tray. Previous grill had a back panel, which kept the bottom shelf cleaner, and you slid the tray out from the front. And…the new tray is much heavier than the previous one making the whole process even more difficult! I would never buy this grill as is, again. I have told many people as well to stay away from this product if they care about a clean grill.
Results.Title: Ridiculous design for tray cleaning
